baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening observation at words 1-6, especially the plural quantifier at word 2 and the form-V w-l-y relation at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus presents a quantified relation map: an observer can identify many, though not all, by the direction in which they close social distance and route support. The covered or denied truth at the receiving pole makes allegiance itself diagnostic evidence.

activation_trace.role: Direct or inward seeing makes the alignment available as evidence to an observer.
Numerical abundance marks a broad pattern while preserving exceptions.
Gapless nearness supplies the topology of deliberately closing distance.
Supportive loyalty gives that nearness an operative social function.
Denial or obstruction of truth identifies the pole toward which support is routed.

changed_reading.before: Many of them are friendly with disbelievers.
changed_reading.after: Many become visibly legible through a chosen topology of proximity and support directed toward a truth-obstructing pole; the quantifier diagnoses a pattern without totalizing the group.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at words 9-19 in which the selves advance something for themselves before divine non-approval, punishment, and abiding.
baseline_models.mechanism: The selves are not passive recipients at the end of the sequence. They act as forwarders, placing their own future condition ahead of themselves. What begins as a relational choice is thus rendered as self-prepared consequence and then as a condition that does not quickly pass away.

activation_trace.role: Forward movement turns conduct into something positioned in advance of its agent.
The self as the very entity involved makes the provisioning reflexive rather than externally assigned.
The opposite of approval names the ruptured divine relation contained in the bad advance.
Severe punitive pain gives the advanced condition its consequential environment.
Durable persistence prevents the result from reading as a passing episode.
Clinging and settling make persistence also a relation of attachment.

changed_reading.before: Their bad deeds later earn punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their own selves pre-position a ruptured relation and a punitive residence for them; repeated attachment has become self-prepared permanence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The flanking contexts join inward security and settled trust to the deliberate acquisition of patrons. The focus alignment therefore operates as a transfer of practical reliance: the chosen protector or supporter reveals where security is being sourced.

activation_trace.role: Support and loyalty provide the focus relation that the context tests against trust.
Inner security and confidence supply the alternative source of reliance at the opening boundary.
Acquisition makes the patron relation a chosen arrangement, not incidental contact.
The patron noun resolves the prohibited acquisition as operative loyalty and support.
Heart-settling assent supplies the counterfactual condition that would block the patron choice.
Chosen acquisition repeats after the focus and confirms volitional installation.
The repeated patron relation closes the contextual frame around the focus.

structural_cues: 5:57 and 5:81 place the acquire-or-take plus patrons construction on opposite sides of 5:80.
5:81 makes belief the explicit counterfactual condition under which those patrons would not be acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trust, acquisition, and patronage in a command-and-counterfactual frame; I infer that patron choice locates operational reliance; alternatively, the frame may regulate alliance without diagnosing an inner transfer of trust.

changed_reading.before: The focus criticizes an improper social friendship.
changed_reading.after: The focus exposes a deliberate patronage arrangement that relocates practical security and authority, making alliance a test of where trust actually operates.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus places chosen nearness beside divine non-approval. The earlier pairing of expulsion with intensified displeasure turns this into a relational inversion: closing the gap toward one source of support corresponds to displacement from divine approval.

activation_trace.role: Nearness without an intervening gap supplies one end of the relational axis.
Loss of approval supplies the focus consequence opposite the chosen nearness.
Expulsion driven by displeasure spatializes the loss of favored relation.
Intensified displeasure sharpens the focus non-approval beyond a passing mood.

structural_cues: 5:60 coordinates expulsion and wrath against the same object.
5:80 coordinates chosen nearness, divine non-approval, and continued punishment in one consequence chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, expulsion, and two grades of displeasure; I infer a reversible proximity axis; alternatively, expulsion and punishment may be juridical consequences without a spatial relation model.

changed_reading.before: God becomes angry because of a prohibited alliance.
changed_reading.after: The alliance performs a proximity inversion: as support is routed toward one pole, the agents place themselves outside divine approval and settle into the resulting distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A concealed truth-obstructing state is carried across both entry and exit without alteration. The focus abiding then reads not only as imposed duration but as the culmination of a practiced capacity to preserve and transport the same inner state through changing boundaries.

activation_trace.role: Crossing inward supplies the first boundary transition while retaining the carried state.
Truth denial is the state explicitly borne through both transitions.
Crossing outward completes the symmetric passage without releasing the state.
Concealment explains how the unchanged interior can survive public transition.
Clinging and settled attachment convert repeated state retention into the focus permanence.

structural_cues: 5:61 balances entry and exit around the same pronominally carried condition.
5:80 adds the emphatic subject pronoun before the abiding predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies symmetric boundary crossings, an unchanged carried state, concealment, and later abiding; I infer habituated state retention maturing into permanence; alternatively, the two verses may describe separate temporal consequences without developmental continuity.

changed_reading.before: Abiding names only the length of the later punishment.
changed_reading.after: Abiding also culminates a rehearsed pattern: the same concealed orientation is carried intact through transitions until mobility hardens into settled attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Speed, skilled production, and reciprocal failure to restrain form a social feedback loop. The focus alliance is therefore not merely a private preference; it is one visible output of a network that accelerates, manufactures, and normalizes conduct because its members do not interrupt one another.

activation_trace.role: Movement opposed to slowness supplies acceleration within the repeated observer frame.
Skilled making upgrades repeated wrongdoing from isolated action to reproduced craft.
Restraint that should stop action is grammatically mutual here and conspicuously absent.
A reprehensible object requiring rebuke supplies what the network leaves uninterrupted.
Forwarding gives the normalized network output a future-directed consequence.

structural_cues: 5:62 repeats the observer, abundance, and condemnation scaffold found again in 5:80.
5:63 substitutes manufacture for ordinary action, while 5:79 immediately supplies reciprocal non-restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speed, manufacture, a repeated frame, and mutual non-restraint; I infer a reinforcing social production loop; alternatively, these may be juxtaposed individual offenses rather than one institutional mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Each person privately chooses the wrong allies and bears an individual result.
changed_reading.after: The patronage pattern is socially produced and accelerated: absent mutual restraint lets a collective practice become the very provision each self sends forward.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inspection reveals directional reversal; following then joins one step to the next, while desire supplies the attractive force and earlier deviation supplies a prior track. The focus allegiance becomes a relay of orientation in which people face toward inherited desire-bearers and transmit departure from the path to many others.

activation_trace.role: Turning the face toward something gives patronage a directional posture.
Unbroken succession lets one oriented act become a transmitted sequence.
Advancing forward links present orientation to what is placed ahead.
Repeated directed inspection trains the observer to diagnose how orientation changes.
Reversal away from a proper face supplies the directional distortion under inspection.
Following behind supplies the relay relation from earlier agents to later ones.
Inclination of the self supplies the force that draws followers onto the inherited track.
Repeated departure from guidance marks both received deviation and its retransmission to many.
Temporal priority makes the deviating track inherited rather than newly invented.

structural_cues: 5:75 repeats the inspection command around an explicit directional reversal.
5:77 sequences following, desires, prior deviation, misleading many, and departure from a path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeing, reversal, following, inclination, priority, and path-loss; I infer a directional relay that links patronage to transmission; alternatively, the focus alliance and the earlier doctrinal following may be parallel errors without one causal chain.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts a static alliance already in place.
changed_reading.after: The focus catches a moving relay: faces turn toward prior desire-bearers, steps follow their track, and the resulting orientation is forwarded to many and into the future.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context keeps operative alliance, spatial nearness, hostility, and affection as separable relational axes. Support can therefore be routed through a conflict-laden field without implying emotional friendship. This sharpens the focus w-l-y relation as patronage or alignment rather than a simple feeling.

activation_trace.role: Operative loyalty and support anchor the focus on what agents do relationally.
A relation spanning endpoints provides the field within which antagonism can persist.
Open hostility shows that membership in one relational field need not entail affection.
Inner aversion explicitly separates felt dislike from outward alignment.
Recurring conflict makes the aligned field politically operative and internally unstable.
Comparative nearness supplies a distinct measurable relation after the focus.
Affection is named separately, preventing its automatic merger with patronage.

structural_cues: 5:64 locates hostility, aversion, and recurring war within the same collective field.
5:82 separately grades hostility and affectionate nearness, while 5:80 says many rather than all.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct lexemes for support, proximity, hostility, and affection; I infer independent relational axes; alternatively, patronage may often include affection even though the context does not require that merger.

changed_reading.before: They emotionally befriend a group they like.
changed_reading.after: Many install or maintain operative patronage toward that pole, even within unstable and hostile relations; the focus condemns routed support, not merely private affection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene runs inward reception through recognition into a visible bodily overflow and then public witness. It supplies a positive control for the focus opening: inner orientation becomes externally legible through what bodies and relations do, so the observer is reading evidence rather than claiming unmediated access to hearts.

activation_trace.role: The focus observer reads an outwardly available alignment.
Hearing as understanding and response begins the inner-to-outer sequence.
Repeated seeing makes the bodily response an observable counterpart to the focus relation.
The seeing organ becomes the surface on which inward recognition is displayed.
Easy overflow from abundance converts interior response into visible excess.
Recognition by a distinguishing sign supplies the cognition behind the visible response.
Knowledge made declarative completes the movement from reception to public alignment.

structural_cues: 5:83 sequences hearing, recognition, visible overflow, confession, and requested inclusion among witnesses.
Both 5:80 and 5:83 address the observer with the same seeing root but display opposite orientations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered inner-to-visible response and repeated observer language; I infer that 5:83 models how 5:80 treats alignment as evidence; alternatively, the tear scene may be exceptional emotion rather than a general epistemic control.

changed_reading.before: The opening seeing verb simply introduces information about the group.
changed_reading.after: The seeing verb marks an evidence practice: chosen relations, like embodied recognition later, externalize an otherwise inward orientation for responsible observation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a social relation onto an eschatological residence. It remains anchored by focus w-l-y nearness and kh-l-d clinging, while 5:86 explicitly couples companionship with the blaze. Render it only as a topological echo, not as lexical identity between patron and companion or as independent proof of causation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The chosen proximity at word 4 and the settled punitive persistence at words 17-19.

activation_trace.role: Chosen social nearness supplies the initial companionship topology.
Clinging and settling harden temporary adjacency into residence.
Companionship as continued association supplies an endpoint relation.
Intensely kindled fire supplies the environment attached to that endpoint company.

changed_reading.before: Wrong companions cause a separate later punishment.
changed_reading.after: Chosen companionship may prefigure its own habitat: social adjacency hardens into the company and environment in which the agents remain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates sweet-water and withholding images around the focus punishment term. It remains anchored by the self-forwarding construction, repeated illicit consumption, and the later flowing-water contrast. Render it as a material resonance of anti-provision, never as an etymology of punishment or a claim of literal thirst.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The selves forwarding something for themselves at words 9-11 into the punitive state at word 17.

activation_trace.role: A prior deposit or standing credit turns conduct into self-supplied future provision.
Palatable fresh water supplies the materially opposite pole activated by the punitive form.
Restraint and weaning supply the exploratory anti-provision mechanism.
Literal consumption grounds the surrounding material economy.
Illicit and defective intake corrupts what is being provisioned.
Unimpeded flow supplies the positive material contrast.
A channel cut by running water stabilizes the contrasting provisioned habitat.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is only externally inflicted pain.
changed_reading.after: The selves may be pictured as provisioning an anti-provision state: corrupt consumption is sent ahead and returns as durable withholding, opposite the freely flowing habitat.

strongest_changes: The flanking command and counterfactual turn patronage into a transfer of practical trust, not generic friendship.
Entry and exit with the same concealed state make later abiding the culmination of rehearsed persistence.
Repeated observer and condemnation frames, skilled production, and mutual non-restraint recast the alliance as a socially reproduced practice.
The context separates support, proximity, hostility, and affection, so the focus condemns operative alignment without reducing it to emotion.
Directional reversal and following make allegiance a relay that carries prior desires forward and misorients many.
summary.what_was_special: The four-pericope window made one social verb participate simultaneously in trust architecture, proximity inversion, institutional reproduction, directional transmission, and visible evidence, while preserving non-totalizing exceptions immediately after the focus.
remaining_uncertainties: The construction introducing divine non-approval can support content, cause, or result nuances; this trace does not force one syntactic relation.
The context strongly supports operative patronage but does not by itself settle the legal scope of every w-l-y relation.
The companionship-habitat and anti-provision readings are controlled cross-domain resonances, not lexical equivalences.
